delivery_os.task.next.description.import: An attempt is reserved and waiting for its result. The agent works outside this system; its result manifest is how the run comes back in.

delivery_os.task.next.description.review: The result is recorded and the task waits for a human verdict. Approve it or request changes; nothing verifies itself.
delivery_os.task.next.description.settle: This task is closed: no attempt is open and no result waits for a verdict.
delivery_os.task.next.description.unknow: The stored attempt register does not satisfy the contract, so it was returned empty. Treat what ran as unknown until it is repaired.
